SAN JOSE, Calif., Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rani Therapeutics Holdings, Inc (Nasdaq: RANI), a clinical-stage biotherapeutics company focused on oral delivery of biologics, today announced that the company’s management team will participate in a fireside chat at the upcoming Chardan Healthcare Conference. Details below:


**Chardan Healthcare Conference**


**Date:** Tuesday, October 20, 2026 at 1:00pm E.T.
**Location:** New York, New York
**Presenter:** Chief Executive Officer, Talat Imran, Chief Financial Officer, Nicholas Maestas, and Chief Business Officer, Kate McKinley
**Format:** Fireside Chat and 1x1 Meetings


Interested parties can access the live webcast for this conference from the Investor Relations section of the company's website at[www.ranitherapeutics.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=sFkR_Kai5L8tvoVB8PSSLKLGrhtxrfiPha0IOht_YyFPVK39e1ufsJOM29mo0boIto-jHFPDPve74AB9lSJRKtRwm-DdodbC0yj0JTY28EnU82J2rs86CGNORw5wUQY2) . The webcast replay will be available after the conclusion of the presentation.


**About Rani Therapeutics**


Rani Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotherapeutics company focused on advancing technologies to enable the development of orally administered biologics and drugs. Rani has developed the RaniPill® capsule, a novel, proprietary and patented platform technology, intended to replace subcutaneous injection or intravenous infusion of biologics and drugs with oral dosing. Rani has successfully conducted several preclinical and clinical studies to evaluate safety, tolerability and bioavailability using RaniPill® capsule technology.
